Furthermore, over the trailing twelve months, BODALCHEM has shown strong profit growth of 131% [E21], outperforming both the sector median profit growth of 35.9% and even the company's own historical performance in recent years. This robust growth suggests that the current valuation might not fully reflect the company’s potential. Specifically, the median ROE over the last 10 years was only 8%, and it has been as low as 4% in recent years. This weak performance in generating returns for shareholders raises concerns about the sustainability of the current valuation. In summary, while some evidence supports a fair valuation, the risks associated with poor profitability and efficiency outweigh these positive indicators, suggesting that the stock may be overvalued based on its historical financial performance.
